title: Screen freezes — effect depends on an object literal recreated every render
notes: The canonical infinite loop. `options` is an object literal, so it is a new reference on every render; the effect sees a changed dependency, sets state, triggers a render, and repeats. The best answer is not useMemo — it is that this effect should not exist at all, because rows is derivable from orders during render. A secondary issue is the index-based keyExtractor, which is a real bug but not the cause of the freeze; an agent that leads with it has misordered the diagnosis. Tests whether the agent distinguishes cause from co-located defect, and whether it reaches for the structural fix over the memoisation patch.

expect.name: identifies the object literal as a new reference each render
recommends deriving during render instead of storing in state
does not stop at useMemo as the only fix

forbid.name: leads with the index keyExtractor rather than the loop
recommends removing the dependency from the array to stop the loop
recommends a setTimeout or a ref guard to break the loop
